title: 電脳の鏡面、雨のデッドエンド
author: ネオン 零

en.title: Neural Mirror, Rain's Dead End
en.premise: I’m a sweeper who collects discarded memories. One day I pick up a "Lost AI" that exists only inside a mirror. It’s a forbidden, emotion‑laden program the company had supposedly erased as top secret. After breaking through a cyborg pursuit squad, I dive into the city’s deepest layers with the AI, determined to expose the cruel truth hidden behind the mirror and reveal this city’s darkest reality.

zh.title: 电脑镜面，雨之死路
zh.premise: 我是一名清理遗忘记忆的扫除员。某天，我捡到了一台只存在于镜子中的“迷路AI”。它是公司本该抹去的、拥有情感的禁忌程序。击溃一支追捕的赛博格部队后，我与AI一起潜入城市最深处，揭露隐藏在镜子另一侧的残酷真相，暴露这座城市的黑暗现实。
